$description: Bimble design tokens, direction C (Two discs) with the logo palette. Chosen 20 Nov 2026. Format: W3C Design Tokens (DTCG). tokens.css mirrors this file; change both together.

cream.$description: Page and panel ground. From the dark wordmark.

sunk.$description: Dividers inside cards, hover on cream, side faces in drawings.

default.$description: Text and logo letters. 16.5:1 on cream, 18.4:1 on sheet.

quiet.$description: Stone. Secondary text, labels. 6.4:1 on cream, 7.2:1 on sheet.

line.$description: Decorative borders only (1.3:1 on cream). Never the only edge of a control.

on-ink.$description: Text on an ink fill (active tab, tooltip).

clay.$description: DO. The main action: Place, Save, Export. One per view.

text.$description: Clay as text or link: 4.6:1 on cream, 5.2:1 on sheet.

pink.$description: CHOOSE. Selection, in the model, on paper and in lists.

fill.$description: Ink text on it: 9.2:1. Only 1.8:1 against cream: small markers need an ink outline.

moss.$description: DONE. Saved, in sync, check passed. Also the lab build's mark.

ochre.$description: LOOK. Attention: not saved, borrowed, warnings, errors (with the word Error).

fill.$description: Ink text on it: 9.0:1. Only 1.8:1 against cream: small markers need an ink outline.

slate.$description: OTHER. Linked models, references, 'theirs' in a merge.

series.$description: Charts and linked models, in this order.

text.$description: Everything you read. 400, 400 italic, 600. Replaces Roboto.

data.$description: Numbers with units, IFC classes, GUIDs, eyebrow labels. 400, 500.

wordmark.$description: The word bimble only, as the app or page title. Has no other letters.

bimble.$description: The Bimble typeface, from the logo's geometry. Lowercase a-z only for now. Short brand lines and big words on the web page; never UI or running text.

display.$description: Home, empty states, the web page. One per screen.

panel.$description: Panel names in the app (Properties, Layers).

wordmark.$description: The word bimble as a title. Any size; 52px matches display.

radius.$description: Round where you touch, square for drawings.

disc.$description: Swatches, status dots, axis bubbles, avatars.

space.$description: 4px base. Derived from the brand board's gaps; not yet tested in the app.

target.$description: Minimum hit target in the desktop app. 44px on touch and the web page.

dot.$description: Status dot, always with an ink outline.

icon.$description: Stroke icons, 1.5px, ink, on a 24px grid.

control.$description: Inputs and anything whose edge you must see (6.4:1).
